items.q: In the StewardMD schematic of the perineal body (inferior view), which structure is the central fibromuscular point where the perineal muscles converge?
items.exp: The perineal body is the central fibromuscular node where bulbospongiosus, transverse perineal muscles and the external anal sphincter converge.

items.q: In the perineal muscles schematic, how does bulbospongiosus differ between the sexes?
o: Midline in males, split by the vagina in females
items.exp: Bulbospongiosus meets in a midline raphe in males and is split by the vaginal opening in females.

items.q: In the perineal body schematic, the two unpaired contributions come from the external anal sphincter and which other source?
o: Longitudinal muscle coat of the anal canal
items.exp: The two unpaired contributions are fibres of the longitudinal muscle coat of the anal canal and fibres from the external anal sphincter; the four paired muscles complete the ten-muscle convergence.

o: A single midline muscle over the openings
